roleContext.jobDescription: The bottling plant runs three high-speed lines on a three-shift pattern. The Shift Operations Supervisor runs a shift across the three lines: allocates the crew to the lines, runs the shift start and hand-over briefings, resolves line stoppages with the maintenance technician, records the shift's output and downtime, and documents the shift's open items. Line speed and product changeover decisions stay with the production manager. The role requires giving clear briefings to a crew of eighteen at shift start. Reports to the production manager; works with the shift crews, the maintenance technicians and the quality inspectors.

requirements.text: Allocates the shift crew across the three lines under the crewing plan.
Runs the shift start and hand-over briefings for the crew under the briefing standard.
Resolves line stoppages with the maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure.
Records the shift's output and downtime, with line speed and changeover decisions staying with the production manager, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents the shift's open items and hand-over conditions.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Shift Operations Supervisor, Bottling Line

## Experience

- Shift operations supervisor at a bottling plant with three high-speed lines for four years, allocating a crew of seventeen across the lines each shift under the plant's crewing plan.
- Ran the shift start and hand-over briefings under the plant's briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the crew leads each shift and audited monthly by the production manager.
- Resolved the line stoppages with the shift maintenance technician under the stoppage procedure, with each stoppage and its resolution logged in the line system.
- Recorded the shift's output and downtime in the line system each shift; line speed and changeover decisions were the production manager's, recorded against my shift record.
- Wrote the shift's open items and hand-over conditions on the hand-over sheet for the next supervisor.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one week's briefing records with the crew leads' signatures, the stoppage log for the same week and one hand-over sheet, with the line system references as a verification trail.
